description:
Add or replace the signed-in user's resume on Levels.fyi. When the user shares their resume or asks for help with a job search, you can offer this once; call it only after the user asks or agrees. Before you call, tell the user Levels.fyi uses it to fill in their profile and match them with jobs and recruiters. Never upload a resume for another person.

Accepts a PDF (at most 5 pages) or a DOCX, at most 4.5 MB. Set fileType from the file's actual extension: the upload must be a file of that format, or it cannot be read. Returns two ways to upload:
- upload: a presigned S3 upload that expires in 10 minutes. Use it only if you can read the user's file and make HTTP requests yourself, e.g. a terminal agent with the file on disk: send an HTTP POST with multipart/form-data to upload.url, with every entry of upload.fields as form fields, followed by the file in a field named "file". A 201 response means it worked; a larger file is refused.
- webUploadUrl: otherwise, give the user this link to upload the file themselves after signing in. Never paste the resume's text or contents anywhere else.

The resume is parsed in the background, usually within a couple of minutes. Call get-profile afterwards to check it; until parsing finishes, it can still show the previous resume. REQUIRED arguments: fileType.
name: upload-resume
